findings.title: Cyberattaque d'un prestataire de l'EFS : Les hackers ont du sang sur les mains | Le Canard enchaîné
findings.summary_md: Le Canard Enchaîné first reported the cyberattack on 3 November 2026, identifying an intrusion against a refrigeration service provider of the French Blood Establishment (EFS). The weekly said the establishment initially described affected samples as part of a transfusion-related health surveillance program before acknowledging that plasma was involved. The report preceded EFS's public statement and formed the basis of later coverage.

findings.title: Cyberattaque contre l'EFS : des hackers s'attaquent aux réserves de plasma sanguin
findings.summary_md: cyberattaque.org reported on 3 November 2026 that freezers normally kept around minus 30 C had been programmed to reach 110 C in an intrusion against the EFS. The outlet noted the incident was first revealed by Le Canard Enchaîné and that it concerned cold-storage installations holding blood plasma. It attributed the compromise to a provider of the blood establishment.

findings.title: Cyberattaque : De -30 à 110 °C… Les réfrigérateurs du don du sang piratés à leur tour
findings.summary_md: 20 Minutes reported on 4 November 2026 that, in the night of 1 to 2 November, intruders targeted Coolworld, a refrigeration service provider for the French Blood Establishment, and attempted to raise the temperature of cold rooms. The report tied the intrusion to the EFS plasma cold-storage sites and named the cooling provider as the point of entry.

findings.title: Une cyberattaque touche des chambres froides utilisées par l'Etablissement français du sang, "sans impact" sur les échantillons conservés – franceinfo
findings.summary_md: Franceinfo reported on 4 November 2026 that supervision and pilotage systems for cold rooms deployed across three EFS sites had been altered, with temperature and defrosting thresholds changed. The public broadcaster said the installations had no impact on conserved samples. The report framed the event as an intrusion against refrigeration installations used by the blood establishment.

findings.title: French blood banks hacked in latest cyber-attack on Europe - The Guardian
findings.summary_md: The Guardian reported on 4 November 2026 that EFS said the attack occurred overnight on Monday, as refrigerator and freezer temperatures in supermarkets across almost a dozen European countries spiked to as high as 50 C. The outlet placed the blood bank intrusion within the wider European cold-chain hacking campaign affecting food retailers. It reported EFS's statement that monitoring detected the change and staff acted in time so no blood products were compromised.

findings.title: Blood banks targeted in latest European fridge cyberattacks - CNBC
findings.summary_md: CNBC reported on 4 November 2026 that EFS was not the direct target of the attack; cold storage units operated by external providers holding EFS blood products were affected across three sites. The outlet placed the intrusion in the context of the latest European fridge cyberattacks. It reported that the blood products were transferred or secured and that no health consequences were identified.
